names: Polyphosphates (i) Sodium polyphosphates (ii) Potassium polyphosphates (iii) Sodium calcium polyphosphate (iv) Calcium polyphosphates (v) Ammonium polyphosphate

more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Polyphosphates is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include processed fish and fishery products including molluscs and crustaceans. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 40 mg phosphorus/kg body weight/day, combined phosphates (EFSA, 2019).
more_info.side_effects:
Estimated combined exposure exceeded the limit in some groups.
Animal evidence supports low acute toxicity.
